text:
Situation: Valproate sodium injection remains on FDA's shortage list as Current since 2020-12-30. The listing names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as affected companies. Corvale East holds 3.8 days of the 100 mg/mL 5 mL vial; Corvale General holds 14.9 days; Corvale Lakeside holds 15.2 days. The 500 mg/5 mL presentation has 17.1 days at Corvale East and 13.3 days at Corvale General.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2020-12-30 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC received an OAI classification letter dated 2017-12-28. Hikma's plant (FEI 3002807173) had an OAI inspection in 2014 and multiple VAI inspections through 2023.

Our position: The rule-ranked option is to transfer 3 vials of 100 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, giving Corvale East 5 days of supply while Corvale General retains two weeks. Alternate concentration products from Hikma and Fresenius Kabi are listed as Current by FDA and have prior pharmacist approvals for dose recalculation. Sagent Pharmaceuticals is not on the FDA shortage list but its manufacturing site is unidentified.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves transfer of 3 vials of 100 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East.
2. Buyer evaluates purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals after confirming manufacturing site.
3. Pharmacist verifies dose and volume recalculation for Valproate Sodium 500 mg/5 mL from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2025-12-04).
4. Pharmacist verifies dose and volume recalculation for VALPROATE SODIUM 100 mg/mL from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2026-04-19).

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
